pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.2: tena kho pana samayena saṅgho sannipatito hoti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū cīvarakammaṃ karontā ekassa chandaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.4: atha kho saṅgho yassatthāya sannipatito taṃ kammaṃ karissāmīti ñattiṃ ṭhapesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.6: evamevime ekamekassa kammaṃ karonti. kassa tumhe kammaṃ karissathāti chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamissatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhu saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamasīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.15.1: “yo pana bhikkhu saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkameyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.1.6: vatthu vā ārocitaṃ hoti avinicchitaṃ, ñatti vā ṭhapitā hoti kammavācā vā vippakatā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.1.8: kathaṃ idaṃ kammaṃ kuppaṃ assa vaggaṃ assa na kareyyāti gacchati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.2.2: dhammakamme vematiko chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.2.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamati anāpatti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.2: saṅghassa bhaṇḍanaṃ vā kalaho vā viggaho vā vivādo vā bhavissatīti gacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.3: saṅghabhedo vā saṅgharāji vā bhavissatīti gacchati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.4: adhammena vā vaggena vā na kammārahassa vā kammaṃ karissatīti gacchati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.7: uccārena vā passāvena vā pīḷito gacchati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.8: na kammaṃ kopetukāmo puna paccāgamissāmīti gacchati,
